// Skeleton of the handler of api.kvp, generated by kvpack: what an
// application gives to the multiplexer, with a method per command. Copy it
// under a name of your own and fill it; this file is written again every
// time the code is generated.
//
// It is written as part of package api. From another package, import that
// one and put its name before the types.
//
//	srv := NewServer(&MyHandler{})
//	err := srv.Dispatch(ctx, m)

package api

import "context"

// MyHandler serves the commands.
type MyHandler struct{}

// OnLogin serves command login (1).
//
//	msg.Request  Login: User, Password, When, Tags
//	msg.Reply    LoginReply, empty, to fill: Name, Expires, Level, Events, Owner
//	msg.Pack()   the reply as a message
//	ctx          what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
func (h *MyHandler) OnLogin(ctx context.Context, msg *LoginMsg) {
}

// OnPing serves command ping (2).
//
//	msg.Request  Heartbeat: no fields
//	(the command declares no reply)
//	msg.Pack()   the reply as a message
//	ctx          what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
func (h *MyHandler) OnPing(ctx context.Context, msg *PingMsg) {
}

// OnQuery serves command query (3).
//
//	msg.Request  Query: Sql
//	msg.Reply    QueryReply, empty, to fill: Code, Note, Limit, Author, Rows, Extra
//	msg.Pack()   the reply as a message
//	ctx          what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
func (h *MyHandler) OnQuery(ctx context.Context, msg *QueryMsg) {
}

// OnEvery serves command every (4).
//
//	msg.Request  Every: RInt32, RInt64, RTs, RText, RBin, RBool, RFloat64, RDs, RMsg, RRec, OInt32, OInt64, OTs, OText, OBin, OBool, OFloat64, ODs, OMsg, ORec, NInt32, NInt64, NTs, NText, NBin, NBool, NFloat64, NDs, NMsg, NRec, OnInt32, OnInt64, OnTs, OnText, OnBin, OnBool, OnFloat64, OnDs, OnMsg, OnRec, LInt32, LInt64, LTs, LText, LBin, LBool, LFloat64, LDs, LMsg, LRec, RSet, OSet
//	(the command declares no reply)
//	msg.Pack()   the reply as a message
//	ctx          what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
func (h *MyHandler) OnEvery(ctx context.Context, msg *EveryMsg) {
}
